info.name: Music Playlist API - Obligatorio 1
info.description:
Full request + test suite for the Music Playlist API (ORT, Desarrollo Full Stack integrado con IA - Obligatorio 1).

Run order matters: folders are numbered and must be run top-to-bottom via Collection Runner (or "Run collection") for the collection variables each request depends on to be populated correctly - this mirrors the exact flows described in the assignment brief (invalid registration -> success -> duplicate; 4 playlists on the plus plan -> limit error -> plan upgrade -> 5th playlist succeeds).

Before running:
1. Run `npm run seed` against the database prod_base_url points at, so the pre-seeded admin account exists.
2. Set the `prod_base_url` variable (Collection > Variables tab) to your API's base URL.
3. Make sure `admin_username` / `admin_password` match your .env ADMIN_USERNAME / ADMIN_PASSWORD.
4. The one request marked [MANUAL] (cover image upload success case) needs a file attached by hand in the Postman UI - Postman collections cannot embed real file bytes portably, so this one can't run unattended.

request.description: Username too short, invalid email, password under 8 chars - all three should be reported.
Creates the primary test user. Saves the token immediately (auto-login) and the resolved username for reuse in later requests.

exec: pm.test("Custom message shown", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("Username or email is required"); });

request.description: Omits "identifier" entirely to trigger the custom required-field message.

pm.test("Explains missing token", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("not logged in"); });
